The time has come for you to climb aboard the legendary robot Grendizer to save the Earth from the terrifying Saucer Beasts!

[h1][i]UFO ROBOT GRENDIZER - The Feast of the Wolves[/i] is now available![/h1]

[previewyoutube=ni5EglXzHS0;full][/previewyoutube]

🤖 For the very first time, play as Grendizer and Umon Daisuke in this action/adventure game, which is all about the metal colossus
🥊 Execute and improve the famous must-have attacks of the giant robot
📺 Find all the characters, iconic places, and enemies of the TV series
🎮 A new gaming experience is offered to you in multiple game phases: Action/Brawler, 3rd person Shooter, Shoot Them Up and Exploration

notes.title: 📺 Prepare for Grendizer’s return on the small screen 📺
notes.content:
Hello Earth Defenders,

Almost 50 years after its first appearance on television, [b]the curtain will rise on a new Grendizer in 2024![/b]

[previewyoutube=khvLQriRdBA;full][/previewyoutube]

[Re]discover the iconic robot from outer space in [i][b]Grendizer U[/b][/i]!

Produced by [b][url=https://manga.com.sa/]Manga Productions[/url][/b], this brand new anime series will feature [b]epic adventures based on Go Nagai[/b]’s characters, starring:
[list][*]Director [b]Mitsuo Fukuda[/b] [[i]Mobile Suit Gundam SEED[/i], [i]Future GPX Cyber Formula[/i] Series]
[*]Character Designer [b]Yoshiyuki Sadamoto[/b] [[i]Neon Genesis Evangelion[/i], [i]Summer Wars[/i]]
[*]Screenwriter [b]Ichiro Okouchi[/b] [[i]Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury[/i], [i]Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion[/i]]
[*]Composer [b]Kohei Tanaka[/b] [[i]One Piece[/i], [i]Sakura Wars[/i] Series][/list]
[h3][i]Space and Earth, do you recall my faded memories?[/i][/h3]
